description: The object that wraps every WebSocket message between a daemon and the hub. Generated from the reference. The rule that ties `payload` to the type `event` is authored.

event_id.description: The id of the event that the message carries, or of the event that an accepted post created.

payload.description: The content of the message. For the type `event` it is a stored Room event.

room.description: The Room that the message belongs to. Set on a message that carries an event, and on a message about the connection that concerns one Room.

sender.description: Who the message is from. On a message with the type `event`, the poster of the event: its agent session with the kind `daemon`, or its member with the kind `dashboard`. On another message from the hub, the hub.

seq.description: The position of an event in its Room. The hub assigns it. Set on a message that carries an event, and on the answer to a post that the hub accepted.

ts.description: A time that the hub sets. On a message with the type `event`, the `at` of the event. On another message from the hub, the time that the hub sent it.

type.description: The message type. It selects the schema of `payload`.

v.description: The version of the wire protocol. This contract describes version 1.

title: Transport envelope
